canonical_data: service-managed project files, Agent conversations and memory, task state, checkpoints, database state, and publishing configuration
current_repo_note: Replit Agent is represented as the proprietary managed coding-agent product, not as the separately editable application code it generates inside a Replit project.
strengths: Planning, code generation, shell execution, app testing, database work, and publishing share one managed workspace
Checkpoints expose diffs and support rollback of files, Agent state, tasks, and optionally development database state
Plan mode, queued steering, skills, connectors, and MCP provide substantial control and extension within Replit
weaknesses: The agent runtime and operational state are proprietary and tied to Replit's managed service
Usage-based billing, account limits, and evolving service terms affect sustained autonomous work
Checkpoint and database rollback choices require care when application state has external effects
why_it_matters: A mature example of a vertically integrated cloud coding agent where workspace, execution, recovery, databases, and deployment are one product boundary.
